Our efforts in selecting rankings for this media

norris beauty clinicIn this column, in order to deliver better medical information to patients, we will introduce the medical services and treatments introduced in the column.objectivity and transparencyWe perform ranking selections with emphasis on.

Our hospital's efforts are:Strict compliance with medical advertising guidelinesOur first priority is to provide information based on scientific evidence.

Our hospital does not rely on simple popularity votes or subjective judgments,Medical evidence, safety, effectiveness, and reducing the burden on patientsWe conduct evaluations from multiple perspectives.

When gathering information,Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfareadministrative agencies such asWe are conscious of delivering accurate information by referring to the official websites of , medical research institutions, and various medical institutions.

In addition, by regularly reviewing the information while always comparing it with the latest medical information,Providing reliable informationWe are maintaining.

Our primary mission at this media is to provide our readers with "rankings that they can refer to with confidence," and we ensure transparency by making the selection process public.

Regarding scoring and flow of ranking selection

The ranking of phimosis surgery clinics in this media is selected based on the following evaluation criteria.

Phimosis surgery clinic ranking selection criteria
  • Ranking score for phimosis surgery
    We refer to official information from public institutions and medical institutions, academic papers, etc., and select clinics based on price, optional costs, technology, safety, ease of access, and support system.
  • Clinic ranking selection process
    ① Information gathering and selection of comparison candidates
    ② Formulation of evaluation criteria and organization of information
    ③ Evaluation and scoring based on objective data
    ④Our clinic doctor will check if there is any incorrect information.
    ⑤Determination of final ranking and publication of article

Please see below for a detailed explanation of how phimosis surgery clinics are scored and the process used to determine rankings.

Details of product ranking scoring

This media has set three criteria that should be particularly emphasized when scoring phimosis surgery clinics.

These areAchieving a good balance between user convenience and medical safetyhas been selected for this purpose.

Fees and optional costs

Technology/safety

Ease of access and support system

Scoring results based on selection criteria

Our media regarding phimosis surgery covers clinics in the following order based on the above evaluation criteria.

Clinic listing order according to selection rules
  • ABC clinic
  • Men's Life Clinic
  • Tokyo Ueno Clinic
  • Atom Clinic
  • MS clinic
  • Nishi-Shinjuku Sugie Central Clinic
  • Aoyama Ceres Clinic
  • Tokyo North Clinic
  • Fire Men's Clinic
  • A2 Clinic
  • Honda Hills Tower Clinic

Ranking selection process

This media's ranking selection is mainly based on the following:5 stepsYou can proceed with

Ranking selection process
  • Information gathering and selection of comparison candidates
  • Formulation of evaluation criteria and information organization
  • Evaluation and scoring based on objective data
  • Our clinic doctor will check if there is any incorrect information.
  • Determination of final ranking and publication of article

From gathering information to publishing articles, we carefully consider and confirm each step.

Through this series of processes,Objectivity and fairness of evaluationWe aim to provide information that our readers can trust.

① Information gathering and selection of comparison candidates

First of all, official information from public institutions and medical institutions, etc.trusted sourcesWe collect a wide range of clinic information based on the theme.

Among them,Transparency in performance and information disclosureBased on these factors, we select candidates for comparison from an objective perspective.

② Formulation of evaluation criteria and organization of information

Next, based on the items that our readers would consider important,Fair evaluation criteriawill be formulated.

Organize the collected information according to the standards,Objectively compare information from each clinicI'll summarize it in a way that I can.

③ Evaluation and scoring based on objective data

Based on the established evaluation criteria, we carefully score each clinic's information one by one.

Without being biased towards a particular clinic,Evaluate all candidates using the same criteriaThis ensures the objectivity of rankings.

④Our clinic doctor will check if there is any incorrect information.

Regarding the evaluation content and the entire article,Doctors of our clinicwill supervise from a professional perspective.

In addition to ensuring the accuracy of medical information, we rigorously check to ensure that there are no expressions that violate medical advertising guidelines.

⑤Determination of final ranking and publication of article

After going through the above process, the final ranking will be determined based on the calculated points.

We create and publish articles using easy-to-understand expressions so as not to mislead our readers.

Legal compliance policy regarding product selection for our media rankings

As a medical institution, our hospital considers it our absolute responsibility to comply with laws and regulations when disseminating information.

In particular, as specified by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare,medical advertising guidelines(Guidelines for advertising, etc. related to medical or dental practices, hospitals or clinics), and other relevant laws and regulations, are strictly complied with, and content is created in accordance with the purpose.

This policy is no exception when creating ranking-style articles in this media.

We take great care to ensure that our readers can make informed decisions without putting themselves at a disadvantage.

Specifically, we have written articles with special attention to the following items that are prohibited under the Medical Advertising Guidelines.

Things to keep in mind according to medical advertising guidelines
  • Comparative superior advertisement
    We do not use superlative expressions that are not based on objective research, such as "No. 1," "No. 1 in Japan," or "The best 〇〇."
    We make it clear that the rankings are only based on specific criteria set by this media, and do not indicate the absolute superiority of the products.
  • hype
    We do not make any statements that excessively exaggerate the facts or guarantee the safety of our products regarding their effectiveness or performance.
    We strive to provide accurate information based on objective data and facts.
  • Experiences of patients, etc.
    As a general rule, we do not publish personal impressions or experiences, as they may give readers false expectations and impede objective judgment.
    The rankings are based solely on objective data.
  • Advertisements with content that impairs quality
    We do not use expressions that impair dignity, such as excessively stirring up anxiety or presenting information with little scientific basis as if it were fact.

In addition to medical advertising guidelines, this content complies with the following laws and regulations when selecting rankings.

In this content,Qualified person familiar with the Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act and the Premiums and Representations Act（YMAA・KTAAetc.) check for inappropriate expressions in advance, and even after publication, the content is updated based on revised guidelines and information from specialized organizations.

Through this system, we provide fair and reliable information and create rankings that allow users to compare and choose with confidence.
